hero.heading: Academic Background
hero.lede: Formal legal, political, and business education, from undergraduate study through to an LLM in progress.

entries.title: Master of Laws (LLM), International Law, Security & Diplomacy
paragraphs: Pursued advanced study in international law with a focus on security and diplomacy, examining how treaty law, transnational crime frameworks, and diplomatic practice intersect in an African and global context.

This programme directly informed my SSRN-published research on advance-fee fraud, which draws on the Palermo Convention, cybercrime instruments, and mutual legal assistance frameworks covered in the LLM curriculum.

entries.title: Bachelor of Laws (LLB)
paragraphs: Completed my foundational legal education, covering constitutional law, contract, tort, criminal law, and procedure, while serving concurrently in student governance roles including Clerk of the Judicial Committee, Vice President of the Law Students' Union, and Legal Affairs Commissioner of the SRC.
Graduated in May 2026, completing my legal training and clearing the way for the professional transition ahead: the Pre-Bar Course at the Ghana School of Law, which I begin on 1 September 2026.

entries.org: Atlanta College of Liberal Arts and Sciences
entries.title: Master of Business Administration (MBA)
paragraphs: Studied business administration and management alongside my legal studies, building formal grounding in strategy, finance, and organisational leadership to complement legal training.
This dual legal and business foundation now underpins both my governance advisory work and the day-to-day running of Lawbenpina Ventures.

entries.title: Bachelor of Arts (BA), Political Science
paragraphs: Studied political science, building an academic foundation in governance, public policy, and political systems that has informed my later work in parliamentary research and student advocacy.
This early academic grounding shaped my long-standing interest in institutional design, which later carried into my work drafting the SRC's constitutional amendments and Standing Orders.

entries.title: Certificate, English Common Law
paragraphs: Completed a focused certificate in English common law, strengthening my comparative understanding of common law doctrine alongside Ghana's own legal system, which is itself rooted in the common law tradition.
This comparative grounding is reflected in my SSRN research, which situates Nigeria's advance-fee fraud framework within colonial-era common law codification and its subsequent domestic evolution.

entries.title: Google AI Professional Certificate
paragraphs: Completed a seven-course professional certificate covering applied AI across brainstorming, research, communication, content creation, data analysis, and app building, building a portfolio of 20+ AI-generated artefacts and one vibe-coded AI solution.

This credential formalised the AI fluency I had already begun applying to legal drafting and research, including the AI-assisted revision process disclosed in my SSRN publication on advance-fee fraud.

entries.title: Google AI Essentials Certificate
paragraphs: Completed a five-course specialisation on responsible AI use and productivity, covering prompting technique, workflow integration, and the ethical boundaries of AI-assisted work.
This grounding in responsible use shaped the disclosure practices I now apply whenever AI tools support my legal writing and research.

entries.title: Level 7 Diploma in Management and Strategic Leadership (Equivalent to Masters)
paragraphs: Studied strategic leadership and management at postgraduate level, covering organisational strategy, change management, and executive decision-making.
This training underpins the governance and administrative leadership I exercise across Commanex Investments, Epic Real Estate, and Jack & Hammer Builders.

entries.title: Certificate in Data Analysis
paragraphs: Studied core data analysis techniques, including data cleaning, interpretation, and reporting.
This analytical foundation supports the data-driven reporting and administrative metrics work I carry out in my role at Commanex Investments.
Completed a further certificate consolidating practical data analysis skills alongside my studies at Queen Mary Academy.
Together with my other data training, this rounded out the analytical skill set I bring to governance advisory and organisational reporting work.
entries.title: Certificate in Data Analysis

paragraphs: Studied paralegal practice, covering legal drafting, case management, and procedural support for legal practice.

This practical training complemented my LLB studies and shaped the document-drafting discipline reflected in the legal opinions and instruments I later produced as Legal Affairs Commissioner of the SRC.
entries.title: Diploma in Paralegal Studies

paragraphs: Completed foundational legal studies covering core areas of law prior to commencing my LLB at Kings University College.
This early legal training laid the groundwork for my formal legal education and the constitutional and governance work that followed.
entries.title: Diploma in Legal Studies

paragraphs: Completed secondary education, graduating as Most Prolific Writer and 2nd Best Student in Economics, while serving as President of the Mouth-Piece Club, Vice President of the Peer Counselors Society, and PRO of the ICT Club.
These early leadership roles were the starting point for the pattern of student governance and advocacy that has run through my academic career ever since.
